name: Crew Neck T-Shirt
label: brown crew neck t-shirt
description:
This unisex Crew Neck T-Shirt from the Uniqlo U collection is designed as a modern essential, balancing a clean silhouette with thoughtful fabric choice for everyday wear across seasons. Crafted from heavyweight cotton jersey made with thick yarn, it offers a smooth surface and a structured look that works well on its own in warm weather or as a reliable layering piece when temperatures drop, reflecting a refined, universal approach to a classic T-shirt.
- Heavyweight cotton jersey fabric made with thick yarn creates a durable, structured feel that holds its shape through repeated wear.
- The smooth finish and classic crew neck deliver a timeless silhouette suitable for casual outfits, travel, and daily routines.
- Binding at the collar helps the neckline maintain its shape wear after wear.
- A neckline inspired by vintage military T-shirt designs introduces subtle character while keeping the overall design minimal.
- The unisex men’s sizing offers a fit that is not too loose and not too tight, pairing easily with straight-leg jeans, chinos, or tailored pants.
- The mid-weight fabric makes this T-shirt adaptable for different weather, worn alone in warmer months or layered under overshirts, cardigans, or jackets.
- Compared with lightweight cotton T-shirts, the heavier jersey provides a more substantial drape and a cleaner, more defined outline.
- Included in the Uniqlo U collection, designed by Co-Artistic Directors Christophe Lemaire and Sarah-Linh Tran, with careful attention to fabric, texture, and refined color selection.
- A versatile wardrobe staple that supports a wide range of styling, from relaxed weekend looks to polished but casual outfits.
-This style was previously sold as U Crew Neck T-Shirt.

name: Crew Neck T-Shirt
label: dark grey crew neck t-shirt
description:
This women’s Crew Neck T-Shirt from the Uniqlo U collection is built around the concept of Unique Comfort, expressing a refined approach to everyday wear through fabric, fit, and proportion. Made from cotton with an interlock-knit jersey construction, it has a clean, smooth surface and a soft yet structured mid-weight feel that works well across seasons. Designed with a regular, balanced fit that is neither too tight nor too loose, the straight silhouette creates a versatile foundation that can be worn on its own in mild weather or layered comfortably as temperatures shift. Designed by Co-Artistic Directors Christophe Lemaire and Sarah-Linh Tran, this piece reflects UNIQLO’s ongoing exploration of what a universal T-shirt should be, combining thoughtful design with functional simplicity.
- Made from cotton with an interlock-knit jersey weave for a smooth finish and refined texture.
- Designed around the Unique Comfort concept, emphasizing ease of wear with clean, intentional lines.
- Features a classic crew neck and straight silhouette with a regular, balanced fit that is neither too tight nor too loose.
- Mid-weight fabric offers more structure than lightweight T-shirts while remaining suitable for layering in transitional weather.
- Developed through repeated testing to refine the shape, proportions, and overall feel for daily wear.
- Part of the Uniqlo U collection designed by Co-Artistic Directors Christophe Lemaire and Sarah-Linh Tran, focused on modern interpretations of essential items.
- Compared with the men’s version, which emphasizes thicker yarn and a more structured feel, the women’s style prioritizes a smoother interlock fabric and balanced proportions.
- Finished in carefully selected colors, chosen through multiple trials to complement the fabric texture and silhouette.
- This style was previously sold as U Crew Neck T-Shirt.
